title: New picking process rollout → orders per hour
teaser: Sites switched after a bad month; the effect ramps up as staff learn.
question: Did the new picking process raise orders picked per hour?
ask: It was rolled out across warehouses over a year.

treatment.name: new_process
treatment.meaning: 1 = new picking process in use that week

outcome.name: orders_per_hour
outcome.meaning: orders picked per labour hour that week

rollout.adopt_meaning: week the new process started at this site (0 = never)

notes.text: Sites usually switched right after a bad month, when managers were keen to try something.
It takes staff a few weeks to get used to the new process.

traps.name: Seasonality
traps.text: Before/after on adopters picks up the peak season.

traps.name: Effect builds up over time
traps.text: With staggered waves, two-way fixed effects mix early and late effects.

traps.name: Switching after a dip
traps.text: A pre-switch dip makes before/after comparisons overstate the gain.
